summary.intent: Execute phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) — 6 plans across 5 waves — including human checkpoint verification of the SDK rewiring of web app hooks.
summary.outcome: Waves 1-3 completed via subagents. Wave 4 (plan 19.1-05) hit a checkpoint requiring live verification; multiple bugs in the SDK-web integration were discovered and fixed (9/10 operations passing). Atomic commits for each fix were in progress at session end.

repo: The monorepo has a dual-path IPNS write problem: folder CRUD goes through the SDK, file upload went through the old service — both write to the same IPNS records, causing 409 sequence number conflicts.
`setApiClientConfig()` from `@cipherbox/api-client` must be called during SDK initialization; without it, all IPNS publish/resolve operations silently fail.
The old `initializeBin` service must complete before `client.loadBin()` is called — SDK bin loading depends on an IPNS record created by the old service at login time.
The SDK's `createFolder` was returning `ipnsName` as the folder ID in the Zustand store, but the file browser looks up folders by UUID (`FolderEntry.id`); new folders were unfindable for navigation.
`ensureFolderRegistered` in sdk-provider was overwriting the SDK's valid IPNS private key and sequence number with stale/empty values from the Zustand store, corrupting subsequent mutations.
The API has conflict-retry middleware in the old service (`withConflictRetry` + `resyncFolder`) that was not replicated in the SDK's `updateFolderMetadataAndPublish`.
A `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` env var exists for E2E integration tests, enabling direct token-based login without OTP flow.
The old web app API client (`apps/web/src/api/custom-instance.ts`) is separate from the new `@cipherbox/api-client` package's `setApiClientConfig` — both exist in parallel.

code.finding: Must call setApiClientConfig() here during SDK init so @cipherbox/api-client generated functions (IPNS publish/resolve) have a configured axios instance.
ensureFolderRegistered should be simplified to skip if SDK already has the folder — attempting to merge Zustand store state with SDK internal state causes key and sequence number corruption.
createFolder must return the FolderEntry's UUID (id field), not ipnsName — the Zustand store and file browser use UUIDs for folder identity, not IPNS names.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needs a single 409 retry that re-resolves the current IPNS sequence number — the API delegates routing can return stale cached sequence numbers.
Rewired to call client.uploadFile() instead of old two-step service — eliminates dual-path IPNS writes that caused irreconcilable sequence number conflicts.
Rewired to call client.downloadFromIpns() — the old service chain used a different IPNS resolution path that failed to decrypt files uploaded via the new SDK.
Rewired to use SDK download path — was using old service directly, causing decryption failure on SDK-uploaded files.
Full lifecycle integration test created: login → create folder → upload → download → rename file → rename folder → delete → verify empty. All 8 operations pass at the SDK level.

workflow: Playwright MCP (headed browser control) is more reliable than Playwright scripts for interactive debugging — avoids selector brittleness and provides real-time visual feedback.
When an agent reports 'failed' with classifyHandoffIfNeeded error, spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits — this is a Claude Code runtime bug, not a real failure.
Using random emails per E2E test run avoids filesystem state pollution from previous runs — clean vault each time.
SDK-level vitest integration tests catch encrypt/decrypt issues much faster than full E2E tests; worth writing before Playwright verification.
Dual-path architectures (SDK for some ops, old service for others) create compounding state conflicts — the fix must be complete migration, not a bridge.

friction: Wave 1 had to be fully re-run after user rejected plan 19.1-02 implementation decisions — branch reset to main and both agents re-spawned.
The dual-path IPNS write problem (SDK + old upload service) caused cascading state conflicts that required multiple attempted fixes before the root cause was identified.
ensureFolderRegistered attempts to bridge SDK/store state created new bugs with each fix iteration (key overwrite, sequence overwrite, children sync) — the bridge pattern was fundamentally flawed.
Playwright script tests were unreliable for this verification due to selector brittleness (+folder button text vs 'New Folder') and timing issues; switching to MCP headed session was necessary.
Background task notification IDs arrived out of order and referred to stale runs, causing confusion about which results were current.
The user had to explicitly instruct the assistant to stop asking for manual verification and drive Playwright autonomously — the assistant defaulted to deferring to the user unnecessarily.
Rebuilding the full package chain (sdk-core → sdk → web) was required after each fix iteration, adding significant latency to the debug loop.
open_items: Bin delete falls back to hard delete — client.loadBin() cannot load the bin IPNS record created by the old initializeBin service; bin integration between SDK and old service unresolved.
Wave 5 (plan 19.1-06: final cleanup, imports, release config) not yet executed — session ended during Wave 4 checkpoint atomic commit phase.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes pnpm -r run build to fail (though per-package builds succeed).
useFileUpload (multi-step upload with progress tracking) and useFileDelete not rewired to SDK — noted in plan 19.1-05 as architecturally different flows, but may need revisiting.
Integration test file at packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts should be moved or cleaned up — it was written as a debugging aid and may not belong in the permanent test suite.
Debug test file at tests/e2e/tests/sdk-debug.spec.ts needs cleanup or permanent adoption as a regression test.
Atomic commits were in progress at session end — commits 1-3 were being staged; remaining fixes (folder UUID, upload/download rewiring, 409 retry) not yet committed.
